templates.name: Minimal Studio Shop
templates.tagline: Ink-on-cream storefront with a sticky nav, restrained cards, and a calm product grid.
templates.best_for: Small-batch, handmade, or design-led shops that want to read as considered and trustworthy rather than loud. Works well for a solo founder or small studio's store.
templates.avoid_for: Streetwear, drop-culture, or hype-driven brands — the restrained palette undersells urgency.

templates.name: Bold Streetwear Shop
templates.tagline: Neo-brutalist storefront: thick borders, offset shadows, and a neon-lime accent on off-white.
templates.best_for: Streetwear, drop-culture, and indie brands that want to land as confident and memorable — the graphic border/shadow system reads as hype-ready.
templates.avoid_for: Contexts that need quiet institutional credibility — the thick borders and neon accent commit hard to a loud, opinionated voice.
